blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — Environmental authorities in Valencia City urged cemetery-goers to practice proper waste management as cleanup crews brace for an estimated 20 tons of mixed garbage across local burial sites during the All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day holidays, or Undas. Julius Parian, head of the City Environment and Natural Resources Office, told the Inquirer by phone on Monday that the projection reflects the city’s usual waste volume during the annual Undas exodus across 21 barangays with public and private cemeteries. The city’s main public cemetery in Barangay Poblacion, Valencia’s largest and most densely populated burial facility, is […]...
